06 — To go live

What we need
from you

01

Trading hours

Google shows these prominently and marks the listing open or closed in real time. Wrong hours cost calls.

02

One listing or three

Umhlanga, Sandton and Mbabane. One listing with the others as service areas, or three profiles to verify and maintain. This changes the scope.

03

Premises photography

Exterior, signage, reception, workspace. Google needs an exterior so people recognise the place on arrival.

04

Verification

Google decides the method, usually a video walkthrough or company documents. Only someone at CyberStoics can complete it.

05

A named approver

One person who signs off the monthly calendar so content moves without chasing several opinions.

06

One title for Mavela

LinkedIn says CIO, the website says Chief Technology Officer. Worth fixing before either channel is promoted.
